description:
The downfall of his clan brought suffering to his kin and turned Luo Zheng, once the envy of all, into a lowly family slave. In a world ruled by mysterious powers and where clans are engaged in endless strife, Luo Zheng, who refused to be defeated, happened to obtain a mysterious manual. With this manual, he refined his body into a weapon. This marks the resounding start to his battle against fate...

(Source: Youku.tv)
